records.description: 他者的价值不是我的价值；他者可以有他自己的价值，而这不由我代给，这件事是我的价值。读不尽，比不了，合不拢——而三条限界推不出「各活各的」。 The other's value is not my value. That the other can have values of his own, and that this is not mine to give, is my value. Three limits, and none of them entails living separate lives.

Linghu Chong learns that freedom is not having no tradition, but being able to move where no teacher has supplied the next approved step.

Five essays on formless skill, public virtue, music across a forbidden boundary, institutions that reproduce domination, and the difference between a bond imposed and a bond chosen.
